title: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center
provider: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center
experiment_summary: Official pages describe normal bearing data and single-point seeded bearing faults introduced by EDM, with documented bearing location, fault diameter, load and acquisition-rate groupings.
notes: Public download availability is not treated as an explicit redistribution grant. MotorPulse AI provides code, source links, handwritten fixtures and summary-only local inspection tooling; it does not republish CWRU measurements.
